exchanges: hey so im finally doing the japan trip in april lol
That's exciting! April is cherry blossom season, so you picked a great time. Where are you planning to go?
tokyo first then osaka. my friend kenji lives in osaka so ill crash with him a few nights
Having a local host makes a big difference. He can probably show you places tourists never find.
yeah hes a chef at a ramen place near dotonbori so free food maybe haha
Free food from a professional kitchen is the best kind of hospitality.
planning is stressing me out tho. marcus keeps telling me to just wing it
Some people thrive on winging it. Is Marcus coming along?
nah my roommate never leaves the city. hes training for the toronto marathon anyway
That's a serious commitment, the training load before a marathon is no joke.
ya hes doing like 80k a week. anyway priya from the climbing gym said shes going to lisbon around the same time as my trip
Lisbon in spring sounds lovely. Do you two climb together a lot?
every tuesday. shes way better than me, shes doing v6s and im stuck on v3
Everyone plateaus somewhere; v3 to v4 is a big jump for a lot of people.
true. oh and my cousin priya, different priya lol, is going to hanoi for work in may
Two Priyas with two big trips. Is Hanoi her first time in Vietnam?
think so, shes nervous about the food. shes vegetarian
Vietnam has more vegetarian options than people expect, especially at Buddhist restaurants.
ill tell her. ok question, jr pass worth it for tokyo osaka and back?
For a simple round trip it's borderline since the price went up; it pays off more if you add side trips like Hiroshima or Kanazawa.
maybe kyoto day trip
Kyoto is an easy hop from Osaka on regular trains, so you may not need the pass for that.
ok cool. also tomasz is watching my cat while im gone, he has a beagle so hopefully they get along
Cats and dogs can work out if they get a slow introduction. Will your cat stay at his place?
yeah his apartment. my cat is named biscuit and shes a menace
Biscuit sounds like she'll keep the dog in line.
lmao probably. what should i pack for april weather
Layers, mostly: mornings can be cool and afternoons mild, plus a light rain jacket.
k. my aunt folake went last year and said bring comfy shoes, she walked like 25k steps a day
That's very realistic, Tokyo is a walking city. Good shoes matter more than almost anything else.
she's a nurse so shes used to being on her feet lol
After twelve-hour shifts, a sightseeing day probably feels easy.
haha true. wait i was wrong earlier, tomasz's dog isnt a beagle its a basset hound, i always mix those up
Easy mix-up, they look alike. Those dogs are usually pretty laid-back, which is good news for Biscuit.
yeah hes super lazy. ok im thinking teamlab planets in tokyo, worth it?
Most people love it; it's very photogenic and you wade through water, so wear pants you can roll up.
oh good to know
Book tickets ahead, it sells out on weekends.
will do. kenji says hell take me to a hanshin tigers game if theres one
A Tigers game at Koshien is a great experience, the fans are famously loud.
im not even a baseball fan but im in
You don't need to be; the atmosphere does the work.
my coworker dami said i should try the onsen in hakone too
Hakone is lovely and close to Tokyo, so it fits well as an overnight trip.
is it ok if i have tattoos? dami has a full sleeve and got turned away somewhere
Some onsen still refuse tattoos, but more places allow them now, and private baths are an easy workaround.
ok ill look for one that allows them. dami also said to get a suica card on my phone
Good tip, a mobile Suica makes trains and convenience stores really easy.
